第两千三十三章 死亡辐射（第1页）
黄泉界主同样是第一时间，得到提醒。
推演过天机，朝紫衫阎王交代了一下，立刻上路出发。
九色夫人同样得到提醒，她也推演天机。
关于这个世界的事情，她就知道的没有那么多了，老实说，也不是很想管那么多。
这七位荒古领武者，联手爆发出的荒古之力，化为的荒古神芒，只怕是就连一般的仙帝，都要退避三舍。
当身上的蚂蚁离开之后，林浩似乎看到了一片黑色的浪潮，那些黑色的浪潮朝周围翻滚着，顺着地下空间无数的洞口中倾泻而出，而阻拦在他们面前的所有生物，都被他们无情的吞噬。
巫腾云将全部的精气神全部凝聚于手中的血芒屠龙枪之中，让这屠龙枪散发滔天凶威，无尽的血芒，撕裂虚空，带着无边凌厉的气势，杀伐果然的勇敢，狠狠的撞在六道轮回拳上面。
“黎老板客气了，您看看需要啥东西，我这边刚刚来了一批新的海鲜，应该能够帮上点忙！”董大海笑着说道。
“如此我就多谢了！只要我能报了大仇，以后有机会，我一定助你成神。”叶天皓对千年火凤郑重的说道。
除非有什么专门修复本源力量的天材地宝，或者，有什么逆天的机缘，当然，这个简直不现实。
“你在梦境里，和我做……做那些事情的时候，心里在想什么？”柳潇潇红着脸问道。
“山海国顶阶仙人！”远远的望着山海国的荒城老祖，常风皱了皱眉头。
那是一名身穿灰色长袍的老者，满脸胡须。此刻，他正气势汹汹地怒视着林夜等人。
“唉？师妹别这么着急走嘛！”然而不等迈步，青年却又一个闪身又迅速横在她跟前，挡住她的去路。
在天阶的等级中，每提升一级，就仿佛攀登上了天梯，对力量的理解就会增加几分，所以这个境界才称为天阶。
“恐怕你们没有以后了！”一声响亮的带着威严的声音想起，随后就是乱哄哄的议论声和唾骂声。
要知道，玄元境一重二重三重武者释放的是元气；四重到六重释放的是气芒；七重到九重释放的则是元气之刃，三种不同的元气变化，代表着由弱到强的提升。

他心里自然不愿意，不过，若是秦宇发出这样的命令，他又必须去做。
这时，苏母南宫风华也从厨房出来。明显也听见了几人刚才的对话，一脸责怪地对苏婉溪训话。
云月答应一声退下了，南宫念昔把医药箱放下，抬眼看了一下房间，正中央是一个实木八仙桌，几个凳子。上面放着一套精致的茶具。
“其他的我也不知道。师傅说的很含糊，只说了伯父是京城的人，其他的没说。”看着萧南期待的眼神，月茗表示无可奈何。自己知道的事情还是师傅告诉她的，她也想帮助自己的师弟，可是她真的没办法。
金先生和另一名杀手之王，一生中可以说杀人无数，想过自己的各种死法，却没有想到，自己会在都市中的别墅里，被吸走一身功力，经脉尽断而死。天道循环，报应不爽，这真是做梦都想不到的死法。
在那一片区域，此刻竟是只剩下一些斗君境和几个一星二星斗圣在战斗，其他的强者，距离这里都比较远一点。

Chapter 2333 Death Radiation (Page 1)
The Lord of the Underworld was also reminded immediately.
After deducing the secret, he explained it to the purple-robed King of Hell and immediately set off on the road.
Mrs. Jiuse was also reminded, and she also deduced the secret.
She didn't know that much about this world, and to be honest, she didn't really want to care about that much.
The ancient power that these seven ancient warriors jointly unleashed turned into an ancient divine light that would make even ordinary immortal emperors retreat.
When the ants on his body left, Lin Hao seemed to see a black wave. Those black waves rolled around, pouring out from countless holes in the underground space, and all the creatures in front of them were mercilessly devoured by them.
Wu Tengyun concentrated all his energy and spirit into the blood dragon-slaying gun in his hand, letting the dragon-slaying gun emit overwhelming power, endless blood light, tearing the void, with boundless fierce momentum, the killing was indeed brave, and it hit the Six Paths Reincarnation Fist hard.
"Boss Li, you're welcome. Take a look and see what you need. I just got a new batch of seafood here, which should be able to help!" Dong Dahai said with a smile.
"Thank you very much! As long as I can avenge you, I will definitely help you become a god if I have the opportunity in the future." Ye Tianhao said solemnly to the Millennium Fire Phoenix.
Unless there is some special treasure to restore the original power, or there is some incredible opportunity, of course, this is simply unrealistic.
"What were you thinking about when you were doing those things with me in your dream?" Liu Xiaoxiao asked with a blushing face.
"The top immortal of Shanhai Kingdom!" Looking at the Huangcheng ancestor of Shanhai Kingdom from a distance, Chang Feng frowned.
It was an old man wearing a gray robe and a full beard. At this moment, he was glaring at Lin Ye and others menacingly.
"Huh? Junior sister, don't leave in such a hurry!" However, before she could take a step forward, the young man dodged and quickly stood in front of her, blocking her way.
In the level of heaven, every time you advance one level, it is like climbing the ladder to heaven, and your understanding of power will increase a little bit, so this realm is called heaven.
"I'm afraid you have no future!" A loud and majestic voice came to mind, followed by a flurry of discussions and curses.
You must know that warriors at the first, second and third levels of the Xuanyuan realm release vitality; from the fourth to the sixth level, they release energy; from the seventh to the ninth level, they release the blade of vitality. The three different changes in vitality represent the improvement from weak to strong.
Naturally, he was unwilling in his heart, but if Qin Yu gave such an order, he had to do it.
At this time, Su Mu Nangong Fenghua also came out of the kitchen. He obviously heard the conversation between several people just now, and lectured Su Wanxi with a reproachful look on his face.
Yunyue agreed and stepped back. Nangong Nianxi put down the medical kit and looked up at the room. In the center was a solid wood Eight Immortals table and several stools. There is an exquisite tea set placed on it.
"I don't know anything else. The master was very vague. He only said that his uncle was from the capital, and didn't say anything else." Looking at Xiao Nan's expectant eyes, Yue Ming expressed her helplessness. What she knew was what her master told her. She also wanted to help her junior brother, but she really had no choice.
Mr. Jin and another king of killers can be said to have killed countless people in their lives. They thought about various ways to die, but they never thought that they would die in a villa in the city, having their energy sucked away and their meridians cut off. The cycle of heaven and its unfavorable retribution is a way to die that you have never dreamed of.
In that area, there were only some Doujun realms and a few one-star and two-star Dou Sage fighting at this moment.The other strong men are a little further away from here.
